title: fopen modes with open
summary: What r, w, a, r+, w+ and a+ mean as flags of open: create, truncate, append and the access mode.
hints: `r` is `O_RDONLY`, `w` is `O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC`, `a` is `O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND`. The `+` modes use `O_RDWR` instead (`r+` has no `O_CREAT`).
The permission argument (`0644`) is only used when the file is created. Check both the result of `open` and the result of `write`.
